# GyanArt

> UX-led digital growth support and conversion-focused website design for small businesses in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

GyanArt is a digital design consultancy founded by Gyaneshwar (20+ years UX design experience) that helps local small businesses, healthcare clinics, and service providers turn website visitors into qualified customer enquiries. Services combine responsive web design, Google Business Profile optimization, and local SEO foundations.

## Core Services

- [Website Design](https://www.gyanart.com/website-design.html): Clear, mobile-friendly websites designed around customer questions, trust, and frictionless call/WhatsApp actions.
- [Local SEO Services](https://www.gyanart.com/local-seo-services.html): Search structure and optimization to help nearby customers find and choose your business on Google Search and Maps.
- [Google Business Profile Optimization](https://www.gyanart.com/google-business-profile-optimization.html): Accurate, high-performing Google Business Profiles with complete service descriptions and review management guidance.
- [Logo & Brand Identity](https://www.gyanart.com/logo-design.html): Practical visual identities for digital and print touchpoints.

## Pricing Packages

- **Digital Foundation (₹10,000):** Up to 5 standard responsive pages, mobile click-to-call & WhatsApp actions, Google Business Profile basics. Typical turnaround: 2–3 weeks.
- **Enquiry Builder (₹25,000):** Up to 10 standard pages, custom styling, conversion-focused page layout, enquiry tracking and measurement setup.
- **Growth Optimization (₹37,000):** Up to 30 pages, tailored service structure, advanced analytics and search measurement.
- **Monthly Maintenance & Local SEO Support:** ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 / month.

## Target Areas Served & Local Corridors

- [Whitefield & Varthur Web Design](https://www.gyanart.com/website-design-whitefield.html): Dedicated website design and local SEO for businesses in Whitefield, ITPL, and Varthur.
- [HSR Layout & Koramangala Web Design](https://www.gyanart.com/website-design-hsr-layout.html): Conversion-focused website design, landing pages, and UX strategy for startups and businesses in HSR Layout and Koramangala.
- **Wider Bangalore Coverage:** Balagere, Marathahalli, Bellandur, Indiranagar, and BTM Layout.
